result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues: a typo in the search placeholder and a partially cut-off/truncated restaurant card in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text is misspelled as 'Restarant, dishes, groceries' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is cut off at the right edge and its name appears truncated (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol'), making it visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal carousel layout with consistent card widths, padding, and scroll snapping so cards and titles are fully visible.
